He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia Bulldogs]]. ==High school career== Gaines attended [[Archbishop Molloy High School]] in Queens, New York. As a senior, he averaged 28.2 points per game, finishing his career as the number 3 scorer in Stanners' history.{{cite web | title = Sundiata Gaines Bio | url = http://www.nmnathletics.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=8800&ATCLID=323799 | work = nmnathletics.com | accessdate = February 2, 2014}} ==College career== In his freshman season at [[University of Georgia]], Gaines had a very productive year as he led the [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Bulldogs]] in minutes, assists, steals, free throw attempts and makes, as well as ranking second in rebounding. In 27 games, he averaged 12.0 points, 4.9 rebounds, 2.9 assists and 2.4 steals per game.{{cite web | title = Sundiata Gaines Stats | url = https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/sundiata-gaines-1.html | work = Sports-Reference.com | accessdate = February 2, 2014}} In his sophomore season, he ranked third among all SEC players in steals at 2.0 per game. In 30 games, he averaged 10.3 points, 5.1 rebounds and 3.4 assists per game. He was named the team's MVP by the coaching staff at the season's end. In his junior season, he led Georgia in minutes, starts, rebounds, assists and steals. He was also named to the 2007 All-SEC second team. In 32 games, he averaged 10.5 points, 5.7 rebounds 4.8 assists and 2.3 steals per game. In his senior season, he was named to the 2008 All-SEC second team and All-Defensive team. In 34 games, he averaged 14.8 points, 6.0 rebounds, 4.2 assists and 1.8 steals per game. ==Professional career== === NGC Cantù (2008–2009) === Gaines went undrafted in the [[2008 NBA draft]]. In July 2008, he signed with [[Pallacanestro Cantù|NGC Cantù]] of Italy for the 2008–09 season.[http://daugman.blogspot.com.au/2008/07/sundiata-gaines-to-play-in-italian.html Sundiata Gaines to Play in Italian League] === Idaho Stampede (2009–2010) === On November 5, 2009, Gaines was selected with the 15th overall pick by the [[Idaho Stampede]] in the [[2009 NBA Development League draft|2009 NBA D-League draft]].[http://www.ktvb.com/sports/Idaho-Stampede-make-good-in-2009-NBDL-Draft-69348237.html Idaho Stampede make good in 2009 NBDL Draft] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140226170938/http://www.ktvb.com/sports/Idaho-Stampede-make-good-in-2009-NBDL-Draft-69348237.html |date=February 26, 2014 }} === Utah Jazz (2010) === On January 5, 2010, Gaines signed a 10-day contract with the [[Utah Jazz]]. On January 14, in just his fifth NBA game, he hit a 3-pointer at the buzzer to give the Jazz a dramatic 97–96 win over the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]]. It was the first 3-pointer of his NBA career.[https://web.archive.org/web/20100119034210/http://espn.go.com/nba/recap?gameId=300114026 Gaines' 3-pointer at buzzer sinks Cavs' late comeback attempt]{{YouTube|-yawMyj4zQU|Gaines game-winning shot to beat the Cavs}} The next day, Gaines signed a second 10-day contract with the Jazz. On January 25, he signed with the Jazz for the rest of the season.[http://www.sportando.com/en/usa/nba/79779/jazz-sign-gaines-for-remainder-of-season.html Jazz Sign Gaines For Remainder Of Season] Gaines joined the Utah Jazz for the 2010 NBA Summer League. On October 22, 2010, he was waived by the Jazz.{{cite web | title = Jazz waive Sundiata Gaines, Othyus Jeffers, Demetris Nichols and Ryan Thompson | url = http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=6705 | work = InsideHoops.com | date = October 22, 2010 | accessdate = October 22, 2010}} === Minnesota Timberwolves (2010–2011) === On November 12, 2010, Gaines signed with the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].{{cite web | title = Wolves Sign Sundiata Gaines | url = http://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/pressrelease_Wolves_Sign_Sundiata_Gaines_2010_11_12.html | work = NBA.com | date = November 12, 2010 | accessdate = November 12, 2010}} On January 4, 2011, he was waived by the Timberwolves.{{cite web | title = Timberwolves waive Sundiata Gaines | url = http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=6995 | work = InsideHoops.com | date = January 4, 2011 | accessdate = January 4, 2011}} === Toronto Raptors (2011) === On January 13, 2011, Gaines signed a 10-day contract with the [[Toronto Raptors]].{{cite web | title = Raptors Sign Gaines To 10-Day Contract | url = http://www.nba.com/raptors/news/20110113/9293/raptors-sign-gaines-10-day-contract | work = NBA.com | date = January 13, 2011 | accessdate = January 13, 2011}} On January 24, he signed a second 10-day contract with the Raptors.{{cite web | title = Raptors Sign Gaines To A Second 10-Day Contract | url = http://www.nba.com/raptors/news/20110124/9933/raptors-sign-gaines-second-10-day-contract | work = NBA.com | date = January 24, 2011 | accessdate = January 24, 2011}} On January 26, Gaines was waived by the Raptors.{{cite web | title = Raptors sign Trey Johnson and waive Sundiata Gaines | url = Nets (2011) === On February 28, 2011, Gaines signed a 10-day contract with the [[New Jersey Nets]].{{cite web | title = NETS Sign Sundiata Gaines to a 10-Day Contract | url = http://www.nba.com/nets/news/Gaines_10day_Release_110228.html | work = NBA.com | date = February 28, 2011 | accessdate = February 28, 2011}} On March 10, he signed a second 10-day contract with the Nets.{{cite web | title = NETS Sign Sundiata Gaines to a Second 10-Day Contract | url = http://www.nba.com/nets/news/Gaines_10day2_110310.html | work = NBA.com | date = March 10, 2011 | accessdate = http://www.nba.com/nets/news/Gaines_Contract_Release_110320.html | work = NBA.com | date = March 20, 2011 | accessdate = March 20, 2011}} On March 23, Gaines suffered a season-ending right hip injury.[http://basketball.realgm.com/wiretap/212543/Sundiata-Gaines-Out-For-Season-With-Fractured-Hip Sundiata Gaines Out For Season With Fractured Hip] ===Armia (2011)=== On September 9, 2011, Gaines signed with [[BC Armia]] of Georgia for the duration of the [[2011 NBA lockout|NBA lockout]].[http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/other-leagues/30909/sundiata-gaines-signed-in-georgia-with-bc-armia.html Sundiata Gaines signed in Georgia with BC Armia] === Return to New Jersey (2011–2012) === In December 2011, Gaines re-joined the [[New Jersey Nets]] after the lockout ended. === Fuijan Xunxing (2012–2013) === On September 6, 2012, Gaines signed with the [[Indiana Pacers]].[http://www.nba.com/pacers/news/pacers-sign-blake-ahearn-sam-young-sundiata-gaines Pacers Sign Three Free Agents] However, he was later waived by the Pacers on October 22.[http://www.nba.com/pacers/news/pacers-exercise-option-george-release-three-players Pacers Exercise Option on George; Release Three Players] On November 13, 2012, he signed with the [[Fujian Xunxing]] of the [[Chinese Basketball Association]] for the 2012–13 season.[http://www.sportando.net/eng/world/asia/46178/sundiata-gaines-signs-in-china-with-fujian.html Sundiata Gaines signs in China with Fujian] === Beşiktaş (2013–2014) === Gaines joined the Washington Wizards for the [[2013 NBA Summer League]]. On November 22, 2013, he signed a two-month deal with [[Beşiktaş men's basketball team|Beşiktaş]] of Turkey.{{cite news|title=Besiktas sign Sundiata Gaines to a two-month deal|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/108416/besiktas-sign-sundiata-gaines-to-a-two-month-deal.html|accessdate=December 5, 2013|work=Sportando.com|date=November 22, 2013}} On January 15, 2014, he played his final game for Beşiktaş, recording 4 points, 7 assists and 2 steals in 15 minutes of play. === Reno Bighorns (2014) === On January 29, 2014, Gaines was acquired by the [[Austin Toros]]. On January 31, he was traded to the [[Springfield Armor]].[http://www.masslive.com/sports/index.ssf/2014/01/springfield_armor_acquire_sund.html Springfield Armor acquire Sundiata Gaines in trade with Austin Toros][http://www.nba.com/dleague/springfield/armor_acquire_sundiata_gaines__2014_01_31.html Armor Acquire Sundiata Gaines Via Trade with Austin] On February 4, Gaines was traded to the [[Reno Bighorns]].{{usurped|1=[https://web.archive.org/web/20140221194612/http://dleaguedigest.com/2014/02/04/source-reno-bighorns-trade-for-sundiata-gaines/ Source: Reno Bighorns Trade For Sundiata Gaines]}} === Guaiqueríes de Margarita (2014) === On April 22, 2014, Gaines signed with [[Guaiqueríes de Margarita]] of Venezuela for the rest of the 2014 [[Liga Profesional de Baloncesto|LPB]] season.{{cite news|title=Gaiqueries de Margarita sign Sundiata Gaines, close to Antoine Wright|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/world/america/117733/gaiqueries-de-margarita-sign-sundiata-gaines-close-to-antoine-wright.html|accessdate=May 4, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=April 22, 2014}} === Sidigas Avellino (2014–2015) === On August 28, 2014, Gaines signed with [[S.S. Felice Scandone|Sidigas Avellino]] of Italy for the 2014–15 season.[http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/132902/avellino-lands-marc-trasolini-and-sundiata-gaines.html Avellino lands Marc Trasolini and Sundiata Gaines] In 29 games for Sidigas, he averaged 11.3 points, 3.3 rebounds, 2.4 assists and 1.2 steals per game. ===Return to the Bighorns (2015)=== In July 2015, Gaines joined the [[Detroit Pistons]] for the [[2015 NBA Summer League]].[http://dawnofthedawg.com/2015/07/05/is-former-georgia-basketball-star-sundiata-gaines-out-of-nba-chances/ Is Former Georgia Basketball Star Sundiata Gaines out of NBA Chances?] On November 2, 2015, he was acquired by the Reno Bighorns, returning to the franchise for a second stint.{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/?id=5066060|title=Bighorns Announce 2015-16 Training Camp Roster|work=OurSportsCentral.com|date=November 2, 2015|accessdate=November 2, 2015}} On December 8, he was waived by the Bighorns after appearing in just four games.{{cite web|url=http://dleague.nba.com/transactions/ |title=NBA D-League Transactions |work=NBA.com |accessdate=December 10, 2015 |url-status=unfit |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20151210163148/http://dleague.nba.com/transactions/ |archivedate=December 10, 2015 }} === Ironi Nes Ziona (2016) === On January 2, 2016, Gaines was acquired by [[Pallacanestro Varese|Openjobmetis Varese]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A|Italian League]].{{cite web|url=http://www.eurobasket.com/Italy/news/433089/Openjobmetis-VA-tabs-Sundiata-Gaines|title=Openjobmetis VA tabs Sundiata Gaines|work=Eurobasket.com|date=January 2, 2016|accessdate=January 2, 2016}} However, before playing a game for them, he left the Italian club on January 13 to sign with [[Ironi Nes Ziona B.C.|Ironi Nes Ziona]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League|Israeli Premier League]] for the rest of the season.{{cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/israel/187828/sundiata-gaines-signs-with-ironi-ness-ziona.html|title=Sundiata Gaines signs with Ironi Ness Ziona|work=Sportando.com|date=January 13, 2016|accessdate=January 13, 2016}} === Salt Lake City Stars (2016–2017) === On November 12, 2016, Gaines signed with the [[Salt Lake City Stars]] of the [[NBA Development League]].{{cite web|first=Hayley|last=Byrnes|url=http://saltlakecity.dleague.nba.com/news/salt-lake-city-stars-acquire-sundiata-gaines/|title=Salt Lake City Stars Acquire Sundiata Gaines|work=dleague.nba.com|date=November 21, 2016|accessdate=November 21, 2016}} In 2017, Gaines competed for The Washington Generals in [[The Basketball Tournament]]. Gaines was the leading scorer for the team with 22 points in the one game they played before being eliminated by The Matadors.{{cite web |url=https://thetournament.com/players/sundiata-gaines
